title: Heal report
description: Written by the governed healer (Lab 4) to heal-report.json in the repository root. One entry per failing test. Checked in CI by scripts/audit-heal.mjs (Lab 6).

release.description: Gremlin Bank release under test (footer 'Release N'), null if unknown.

tool.description: AI tool, for example claude-code, copilot-vscode, copilot-cli, codex, cursor, opencode, antigravity.

model.description: Model name as the tool shows it.

requestedBy.description: Who asked for the heal (GitHub username or name).

file.description: Test file path relative to the repository root, for example tests/transfer.spec.ts

error.description: First line of the failure message.

classification.description: DRIFT: the UI changed, the behaviour is the same. BUG: the behaviour changed. UNSURE: cannot tell.

reason.description: Why this classification, in one or two sentences.

change.description: What the healer changed. 'none' for UNSURE; for BUG only the test.fail() marker and comment.

expectedValueChanged.description: Whether an expected value in an assertion changed. The governed healer always writes false.

expected.description: Expected value (required for BUG), with the rule it comes from.

observed.description: Value the application showed (required for BUG).

tracePath.description: Trace of the failing run, for example test-results/<test>/trace.zip

humanSignOff.description: Added by a person (not by the agent) who accepts a changed expected value.
